review_expiry_rule: The review validity window is a project control, not a source claim. If the acceptance-session date is later than valid_until, live collection is HOLD and exits 4 until this file is re-reviewed and re-frozen; the runner must not extend the date automatically.
scope: Phase 1 live incremental collection for low-frequency internal research raw evidence only

baseline_separation.rule: This policy applies only to source-mode=live with mode=incremental. Bootstrap and every source-mode=snapshot run continue to use the frozen source-catalog.json and collection-policy.json without reinterpretation.

network_policy.request_plan_rule: Only the exact static endpoints declared in this file may enter the current live request plan. A calendar, expected issue number, timestamp cache-buster, discovered child, or guessed future URL is never a request source.

preflight.stage_rule: These checks finish before a request plan or run is created.

runtime.stage_rule: These failures occur only after a run and request_started attempt exist. Append and flush exactly one request_failed terminal for that attempt. A retryable attempt-1 failure schedules exactly one attempt-2 after the frozen delay; a non-retryable or exhausted failure rejects the run, creates no release, and leaves current-release.json unchanged.

acceptance_mapping.rule: The product CLI/preflight supplies the underlying exit code. When E2E-05 or G3 classifies that outcome as HOLD, the acceptance report preserves underlying_exit_code and the acceptance runner exits 20.

recheck_policy.new_issue_target_rule: Any newly observed issue is a target; a missing required source pair is unresolved and rejects publication.
recheck_policy.existing_complete_pair_rule: Inside the latest-20 per-game window, a complete required pair follows normal unchanged, revised, or conflict handling; any extra dissent blocks publication.
recheck_policy.deferred_rule: For an existing target with an incomplete required pair, if every available observation equals the current draw core, retain the old draw and evidence, record RECHECK_DEFERRED_MISSING_PARTNER, do not count unresolved, do not block, and do not claim the recheck complete.
recheck_policy.unconfirmed_change_rule: For an existing target with an incomplete required pair, any available observation whose core differs from the current draw is RECHECK_UNCONFIRMED_CHANGE, unresolved, and rejects publication.

sources.query_rule: The query string and parameter values are exact and immutable; callers must not change view, limit, parameter order, or add parameters.

known_limits: robots.txt returned a soft-404 page at review time rather than an explicit policy file.
The reviewed JSON endpoint is authorized only at its exact queryless URL; timestamp cache-busters and arbitrary query strings are outside the current profile.
One observed response does not establish a long-term publication-time SLA.
